run_nougat_api_server: run the nougat fastapi server on port 8503 using uvicorn
predict_pdf_to_markdown: send a PDF file to the predict endpoint to extract text in markdown format
predict_pdf_page_range: send a PDF file with start and stop page numbers to extract a specific page range
load_model_on_startup: load the nougat pretrained model on device during fastapi startup event
health_check_root: call the root endpoint to verify the nougat api server is running
